name: wait_for_event_effect_package_load

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_WaitForEventEffectPackageLoad takes no Script context and returns scheduler state 4 while asynchronous event-effect package load bit 44 is set, or state 2 after it clears

notes: The completion callback func_001DEDF8 clears the bit set by commands 165 and 734 after the paired event-effect package load finishes; func_001DEE48 queues the second file and installs func_001DEDF8 as its completion callback. The JP corpus contains 19 polling calls.
